title: [review] duty_cycle.rs: debug_assert only validates duty_permille in debug
description: with_duty_permille uses debug_assert! to validate duty_permille is in range (1..=1000). In release builds, these assertions are stripped. Passing duty_permille=0 causes max_tx_ms() to return 0, silently blocking all transmissions. Consider using assert! or returning Result<Self, Error> for constructor validation.
